name: plcsim_run_sequence
description: Execute a generic automated online sequence test on any PLC sequence/state machine in S7-PLCSIM Advanced. Writes initial/recipe tags, triggers start, tracks step progression, polls monitored tags, and generates an execution telemetry report.

sequence_name.description: Name or ID of the sequence under test (e.g. 'BottlingCycle', 'PressSequence').

start_command_tag.description: Tag name to pulse TRUE to initiate the sequence (e.g. 'DB_Seq.cmdStart').

reset_command_tag.description: Optional tag name to pulse TRUE to reset the sequence before starting.

step_number_tag.description: Tag name holding the current sequence step/state number (e.g. 'DB_Seq.currentStep').

step_name_tag.description: Optional string tag name holding current step name.

fault_tag.description: Optional tag name indicating sequence fault/alarm.

idle_step.description: Step integer value that indicates idle state (default 0).

initial_tags.description: Optional key-value map of tags to initialize before sequence start.

parameter_tags.description: Optional key-value map of recipe/setpoint parameters to apply.

monitored_tags.description: Optional array of tag names to sample in real-time telemetry.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for sequence completion (default 60).
